13FDI in Industrial Estate in Thailand Breakdown 2025 
•BOI: In 2025 , investment  promotion  applications  had a total value  
of Baht 1.88 trillion,  increasing  67.2% YoY from Baht 1.12 trillion  in 
the previous  year, driven  primarily  by the digital  industry,  which  had 
an investment  value  of Baht 746.2 billion,  increasing  206.7% YoY, as 
well as the electrical  appliances  and electronics  industry,  value  of 
Baht 277.7 billion,  increasing  20.9% YoY, reflecting  the expansion  of 
investment  in technology  infrastructure  and increased  production  
of smart  devices .Source :Thailand Board of InvestmentUnit: Million BahtINDUSTRIAL ESTATE OUTLOOK
•Digital  Industry  and Electrical  Appliances  & Electronics  Industry : The 
digital  industry  continued  to lead in investment  with a total value  
over Baht 746.2 billion  from 151 projects,  with data centers  serving  
as a key driver  to support  the growth  of cloud  computing  and 
artificial  intelligence . Meanwhile,  the electrical  appliances  and 
electronics  industry  recorded  a total investment  value  of Baht 277.7 
billion  from 470 projects,  led by the manufacturing  of electronic  
circuit  boards,  semiconductors,  and batteries,  reflecting  the 
ongoing  transition  toward  advanced  technology .
•Smart  & Sustainable  Industry : In 2025 , there  were 473 applications  
for investment  promotion,  with a total investment  value  of Baht 
68.3 billion,  increasing  by 99%, with most  investments  aimed  at 
enhancing  production  efficiency  through  the application  of digital  
technology,  machinery  improvement  and replacement,  as well as 
the implementation  of automation  systems  in production  lines,  
reflecting  the acceleration  of Thailand’s  industrial  sector  toward  
smart  and sustainable  industry  standards .
•Industry  Outlook : Thailand  remains  one of the key destinations  for 
investment  from China  into the ASEAN  region . In 2026 , investment  
is expected  to continue  expanding,  driven  by the relocation  of 
production  bases  to ASEAN,  alongside  accelerated  investment  in 
digital  and artificial  intelligence  industries,  such as data centers  and 
semiconductors,  as well as clean  energy . Moreover,  Thailand’s  well-
developed  infrastructure  and continued  investment  promotion  
policies  will serve  as key supporting  factors  in attracting  long term
